Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 87. Category: form. Legendary Grades.

You master the rage and instead channel it through
your controlled Super Saiyan, losing the raw strength
but gaining a mastery of the form as you learn to control
your rage through your Super Saiyan state
Increase your Power by 2
At the end of your turn, you lose 1 Stamina
This form does not take up your transformation slot.
The Combination Form of Controlled Super Saiyan 1
and Legendary Grade 4 can be activated as a Bonus
Action.
Broly (Super Saiyan)
